messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty - API-GW-EDGE-502 spike detected in us-west-2 (~20% 1m error rate).
Alice M.: acked. oncall - jumping in. visualizing... please don't escalate to customers yet.
Ben K.: I see 502s on edge proxies, upstream 200 responses mostly but proxy returning 502. Correlation with recent config push? checking.
Carla S.: running prom query: `sum(rate(api_gateway_responses{code=~"5..",zone="us-west-2"}[1m])) by (code)` shows 502 spike starting 17:02 UTC
Alice M.: rolling back last envoy route change to canary-2026-03-17 at traffic-router. command:
```
kubectl -n ingress rollout undo deployment/edge-router --to-revision=3
```
Ben K.: undo queued, but rollback may take 30-60s. Can we apply failfast so downstream doesn't pile up?
Carla S.: enabling failfast on edge-router for path /v1/generate:
```
POST /_admin/config
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "failfast": true }
```
Dave (support): we already have two customers reporting elevated latencies and errors (CS ticket #7248, #7251). Not yet widespread but noisy.
Alice M.: set emergency rate-limit on long-tail clients at the edge to reduce fanout. applying token bucket throttle.
Eve P.: should we start customer notice? recommend targeted notices to impacted accounts after mitigation.
Ben K.: rollback done, proxies restarting, 502s dropping from 20% -> 6% in last 45s.
Carla S.: KV cache metrics look stable. Investigating connection pool exhaustion to upstream inference cluster. `netstat` shows many TIME_WAITs.
Alice M.: switching traffic for us-west-2 to warm-fallback pool (capacity-reserve) to reduce pressure.
Ben K.: traffic shift initiated via router policy, 10% -> 40% over 60s.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert rate now 2.1% 1m.
Dave (support): updating CS tickets, letting affected customers know we mitigated, offering to escalate if they still see errors.
Eve P.: logging action items: postmortem, add automated detection for route config rollbacks, verify circuit-breaker defaults.
Carla S.: adding follow-up: run load test against edge-router with same connection churn pattern.
Alice M.: handing off to Ben for next 2 hours to monitor, I'll be offline. Ben -- please open incident doc when stabilized.
Ben K.: taking over. I'll keep watch and create incident page with timeline and mitigation steps.
Alice M.: thanks all. good job moving fast. :thumbsup:
Ben K.: initial incident doc stub: /incidents/3555550000 - collecting logs and traces, will attach.
incident-bot: :spiral_note_pad: Incident acknowledged and assigned to Ben K. Severity: Sev2. Follow-up ticket created: REDWOOD-INC-2026-178.
